Straight-down view of layered paper-cut coastline contours in graded blues, built as a survey map, flat and calm. Subject centred with a generous quiet margin around it, every key element near the middle of the frame. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: a small amber glass disc resting on one contour near the middle of the map. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
